mode.sectionDescription: Choose where scheduling data comes from. `live` and `hybrid` call the Cal.com API v2; `demo` makes no network calls and emits clearly-labelled synthetic data.
mode.title: Mode
mode.description: live = Cal.com scheduling data only. hybrid = Cal.com scheduling data plus synthetic demo workforce metadata for any Cal.com user with no metadata entry. demo = fully synthetic hospital roster, no API calls, no credentials needed.
enumTitles: hybrid - Cal.com + demo workforce metadata fallback
demo - synthetic data only (no API calls)

apiKey.title: Cal.com API key
apiKey.description: Cal.com API key (starts with `cal_`). Required for `live` and `hybrid` modes. Sent as an `Authorization: Bearer` header. Never logged. Falls back to the CAL_COM_API_KEY environment variable when left empty.

baseUrl.title: Cal.com API base URL
baseUrl.description: Base URL of the Cal.com API v2. Change only for self-hosted Cal.com instances.

icsUrl.title: iCal feed URL (instead of Cal.com)
icsUrl.description: Read the roster from any calendar's iCalendar (.ics) feed instead of Cal.com - e.g. Google Calendar's "secret address in iCal format", an Outlook published calendar or iCloud. Each timed event is a shift; its guests (not the organizer) are the people working it. No Cal.com key is needed when this is set. Treated as a secret: never logged. Falls back to the ICS_URL environment variable.

sickPrefix.title: Sick-report title prefix (iCal)
sickPrefix.description: An iCal event whose title starts with this text (case-insensitive) was reported sick: it is emitted as a cancelled shift and not counted towards hours.

startTime.sectionDescription: All timestamps in the output are ISO-8601 in UTC. Date-only values are interpreted as UTC midnight.
startTime.title: Window start
startTime.description: Start of the scheduling window. Accepts an ISO-8601 timestamp (2026-09-26T00:00:00Z), a date (2026-09-26), `now`, or a relative offset such as `now-1d` / `now+2h`.

endTime.title: Window end
endTime.description: End of the scheduling window. Same formats as the window start. Must be after the window start.

maxDateRangeDays.title: Maximum window length (days)
maxDateRangeDays.description: Safety cap on the window length. The run fails fast instead of paginating through an unbounded range.

teamIds.sectionDescription: Leave every filter empty to retrieve everything the API key can see.
teamIds.title: Team IDs
teamIds.description: Restrict retrieval to these Cal.com team IDs. Empty = all teams the key can access.

eventTypeIds.title: Event type IDs
eventTypeIds.description: Restrict bookings to these Cal.com event type IDs. Empty = all event types.

usernames.title: Cal.com usernames
usernames.description: Restrict event-type lookups to these Cal.com usernames. Empty = the authenticated user and every accessible team.

bookingStatuses.title: Booking statuses
bookingStatuses.description: Cal.com booking statuses to retrieve. Each status is a separate paginated API walk. Empty = a single unfiltered walk across all statuses.

includeTeamMemberships.title: Retrieve team memberships
includeTeamMemberships.description: Call /v2/teams and /v2/teams/{id}/memberships to discover the workforce roster. This is the primary worker source in live mode.

includeEventTypes.title: Retrieve event types
includeEventTypes.description: Call /v2/event-types and /v2/teams/{id}/event-types to discover additional hosts and to resolve shift roles from event types.

includeSchedules.title: Retrieve availability schedules
includeSchedules.description: Call /v2/schedules and project the authenticated user's weekly availability into the requested window. Cal.com only exposes schedules for the authenticated user.

emitSchedulingEvents.title: Emit raw scheduling events
emitSchedulingEvents.description: Also emit one schedulingEvent record per Cal.com booking, next to the derived shift records. Useful for auditing what the scheduling system actually returned.

employeeMetadata.sectionDescription: Cal.com does not store employee IDs, roles, departments, skills or contracted hours. Supply them here from your roster system. Every field that comes from this source is labelled workforce-metadata in the output, never cal.com. Do not put medical information or absence reasons in here.
employeeMetadata.title: Employee metadata (inline)
employeeMetadata.description: Array of employee metadata objects, matched to Cal.com users by email (case-insensitive), then calUsername, then calUserId. Example item: {"employeeId": "E101", "email": "sarah@example.com", "role": "ICU_NURSE", "department": "ICU", "skills": ["ICU", "BLS"], "contractedHoursPerWeek": 36}

employeeMetadataUrl.title: Employee metadata URL
employeeMetadataUrl.description: HTTPS URL returning a JSON array of employee metadata objects, or an object with an `employees` array. Merged with the inline list; inline entries win on conflict.

employeeMetadataStoreKey.title: Employee metadata key-value store key
employeeMetadataStoreKey.description: Key in an Apify key-value store holding a JSON array of employee metadata objects. Handy for keeping the roster out of the run input.

employeeMetadataStoreId.title: Employee metadata key-value store ID
employeeMetadataStoreId.description: ID or name of the key-value store to read the metadata key from. Defaults to the run's own key-value store.

shiftTypeMetadata.title: Shift type metadata
shiftTypeMetadata.description: Maps Cal.com event types to shift requirements. Match on eventTypeId or eventTypeSlug. Example item: {"eventTypeSlug": "icu-night-shift", "role": "ICU_NURSE", "department": "ICU", "requiredSkills": ["ICU", "BLS"]}

useDemoWorkforceMetadata.title: Fall back to demo workforce metadata
useDemoWorkforceMetadata.description: When a Cal.com user has no metadata entry, synthesize a clearly-labelled demo one. Always on in hybrid and demo modes. Such records are labelled demo-workforce-metadata and flagged synthetic true.

pageSize.title: Page size
pageSize.description: Items requested per API page. Cal.com caps bookings at 100.

maxPagesPerResource.title: Max pages per resource
maxPagesPerResource.description: Hard stop on pagination loops per API resource. Reaching it is reported as a warning and marks the run partial.

maxRecordsPerResource.title: Max records per resource
maxRecordsPerResource.description: Hard stop on how many raw records are pulled per API resource.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Per-request timeout. Timed-out requests are retried according to the retry limit.

maxRetries.title: Max retries
maxRetries.description: Retries for network errors, request timeouts, HTTP 429 and HTTP 5xx, using exponential backoff with jitter and honouring Retry-After.

failOnEmptyResult.title: Fail when no workers are found
failOnEmptyResult.description: Fail the run when the API call succeeded but produced zero worker records. Leave off to get a successful run whose summary record carries emptyResult true. Either way, an API failure always fails the run - it never turns into an empty dataset.

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Raise the log level to DEBUG. Credentials are censored at every log level.
